propositions: Add new plan-review criterion T15 to require proving risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiment before committing to slow delivery loops

T15 applies when a mechanism is delivered through automated pipeline/infrastructure apply, the loop is slow/costly, and correctness depends on runtime behavior only resolving in a realistic environment
The criterion enforces naming specific runtime-only risks and proving each via the fastest available path—local/emulated execution or manual real-target experiment—before committing to the slow loop
T10 must be partitioned to exclude transient de-risk experiments, ensuring the durable infrastructure scope does not overlap with T15's transient proof phase
T15 guidance must be reflected in plan-review documentation, criteria guide, and writing-a-passing-plan guide via automated registry regeneration and validator passes
